The game has a lot of potential but the Quality of Life isn't there. It feels rushed putting this into 1.0 whenever you have so many core mechanics that feel super clunky.

I'd recommend that the developers play one play through where they kind of wander around and do beginner salvaging for a while and take note of all the little inconveniences in the game (or if they think they can't do that without speed running omega strong gear, they get someone else to play and they watch).

For example, when you set a task and try to go do something else briefly (say you need to go get food or water at a kiosk or a derelict) and you walk out of you air lock in the common sense manner (waiting for the airlock door to close so you don't lose pressure) your character will take control anytime you idle for more than 1 second while waiting and barrel through the airlock releasing all the air in your ship while trying to reach the task you had set and walked away from. THE WORST PART IS! The character is NOT in Autotask mode and will keep going back to it until you cancel it (because you can't pause it)! A smart person or a dev might say to this "just go to the roster and prohibit the character from opening the airlock", guess what! That means that I cannot open the airlock either! 

or

If you are trying to expand your ship using the walls, floors, and conduit of a derelict when you set a task of installing the components, the character takes one. piece. at. a. time. back. and. forth. forever. 
That gets really old. really fast. and if you want to speed it up by manually picking up every. single. tile. you have to click an average of 3-5 times for every single tile. Once you move to the tile, once to select the grid, once more to select the tile (or spam click until the "lottery" layers give you the floor tile), and another time to select the "pick up" button.

or

If you want to find someone for a goal and it brings you to the social app. You find the person, then select their location, you're 1 tile outside of your ship so you can't access your docked ship's NAV map. You have to then close the PDA, go into your ship, go to the goal, go to the person, then go to their location, and finally... their location can't be found. At this point you have 2 or 3 options, you can get everything ready to undock your ship and travel far enough from and visual or radio obstruction to then go through the whole process to find the person's location again and finally... you still can't find them on the map or thru the hailing system. They are gone. They have ceased to exist. The last option is to wait, seemingly indefinitely for them to come back to what ever station/system you are in. The cherry on top is that everytime you go to the social app, you have to re-find the person everytime and there is not search bar. You have to scroll through everytime. And it doesn't put you at the top or both of the list, it puts you in the middle so you have to search twice to find a person. Scrolling your mouse skips along the pages so you don't even know if you have passed them already (I will note that there is a scroll bar but why can't I use my mouse scroll???).


These things are all CORE mechanics that you WILL use throughout the entirety of your play through. Why are they still not fixed? And this is just the tip of the iceberg there are SO MANY systems that rely on the examples that I used. In effect, this is like building a house and not pouring the foundation so the house is crooked and leaning to the side.
items.text_zh:
这款游戏潜力巨大，但生活质量方面却差强人意。当你还有那么多核心机制感觉超级笨拙的时候，把它放进1.0版本感觉太仓促了。

我建议开发者玩一遍游戏，四处闲逛，做一会儿新手打捞，并记录下游戏中所有的小不便（或者如果他们觉得不速通拿到超强装备就做不到，那就让别人来玩，他们在旁边看）。

比如说，当你设定了一个任务，然后想短暂地去做点别的事（比如你需要去售货亭或废弃飞船弄点食物或水），你以常识方式走出气闸（等待气闸门关闭以免失去气压），你的角色会在你等待时闲置超过1秒的任何时候接管控制，冲过气闸，释放你飞船里的所有空气，试图到达你设定后又走开的任务。最糟糕的部分是！角色并没有处于自动任务模式，会一直回去直到你取消它（因为你无法暂停它）！一个聪明人或开发者可能会说“直接去花名册禁止角色打开气闸”，你猜怎么着！那意味着我也不能打开气闸了！

或者

如果你试图用废弃飞船的墙壁、地板和管道来扩展你的飞船，当你设定安装组件的任务时，角色会一次。一。件。地。来回。永远。
那真的很快。就让人厌烦。如果你想通过手动拾取每。一。个。地砖来加速，你必须为每个地砖平均点击3-5次。一次移动到地砖，一次选择网格，再一次选择地砖（或者狂点直到“抽奖”层给你地板砖），还有一次选择“拾取”按钮。

或者

如果你想为某个目标找人，它带你到社交应用。你找到那个人，然后选择他们的位置，你在飞船外1格，所以无法访问你停靠飞船的导航地图。你必须关闭PDA，进入你的飞船，去目标，去那个人，然后去他们的位置，最后……他们的位置找不到了。此时你有2或3个选项，你可以准备好一切，解开飞船停靠，行驶到远离任何视觉或无线电障碍的地方，然后重新走整个流程再次找到那个人的位置，最后……你仍然无法在地图上或通过呼叫系统找到他们。他们消失了。他们不复存在了。最后一个选项是等待，似乎无限期地等待他们回到你所在的任何空间站/星系。最妙的是，每次你去社交应用，你都必须重新找到那个人，而且没有搜索栏。你必须每次都滚动浏览。而且它不会把你放在列表的顶部或底部，而是放在中间，所以你必须搜索两次才能找到一个人。鼠标滚动会跳过页面，所以你甚至不知道是否已经经过了他们（我会注意到有一个滚动条，但为什么我不能用鼠标滚轮？？？）。


这些都是核心机制，你会在整个游戏过程中一直使用。为什么它们还没有被修复？而这只是冰山一角，有太多系统依赖于我用的这些例子。实际上，这就像建房子却不打地基，所以房子歪歪扭扭，向一边倾斜。
房子是歪的，向一侧倾斜。

items.text:
Most of the positive reviews seem to follow the same pattern: "I love this game, however..." or "This is a great game, but..."

And that's exactly the problem. It could be a great game, but right now too much of it is either broken or poorly designed. Unless you're an experienced player who already knows how to work around bugs and identify important yet poorly communicated information, the game can feel incredibly inaccessible.

Take K-Leg, the starting station, as an example. You'll regularly find NPCs lying on the ground wearing pressure suits. The issue is that these suits don't have oxygen tanks; they only contain whatever air pressure is already inside them. So these NPCs have somehow decided that, while standing in a perfectly safe, breathable station, they should wear what is effectively a plastic bag over their heads.

The same kinds of problems extend into more complex systems later in the game. Crewmates, for instance, will sometimes wander outside the ship into the vacuum of space to repair something without putting on a spacesuit first. Or if they are wearing a suit, they'll wear it until they drop dead.

There are other baffling design decisions. You can stack floor tiles, but walls have to be placed one by one through dragging. Every few minutes, you find yourself returning to the ship just to remove your helmet, put it back on again, and carry on.

None of this is fun. It's not particularly realistic either. They're simply quirks players learn to tolerate and work around as quickly as possible. Instead of enjoying the game, it often feels like you're battling against its cumbersome systems and questionable design choices.

I would love to recommend this game, I'll likely continue playing it despite the problems, but for most people i'd say steer clear unless you're willing to deal with frustration.
items.text_zh:
大多数好评似乎都遵循同样的模式：“我喜欢这款游戏，但是……”或者“这是一款很棒的游戏，但……”

而这正是问题所在。它本可以是一款很棒的游戏，但现在它有太多部分要么是坏的，要么是设计得很糟糕。除非你是一名经验丰富的玩家，已经知道如何绕过bug，并识别那些重要但传达得很差的信息，否则这款游戏会让人感觉极其难以入门。

以K-Leg，也就是起始空间站为例。你会经常发现NPC穿着压力服躺在地上。问题在于，这些压力服没有氧气罐；它们只包含里面已有的空气压力。所以这些NPC不知怎么地决定了，虽然站在一个完全安全、可呼吸的空间站里，他们也应该把实际上相当于塑料袋的东西套在头上。

同样类型的问题延伸到游戏后期更复杂的系统中。比如船员，有时会不先穿上宇航服就游荡到飞船外面的真空中去修理东西。或者如果他们穿着宇航服，他们会一直穿着，直到倒地死亡。

还有其他令人费解的设计决定。你可以堆叠地板砖，但墙壁必须通过拖拽一块一块地放置。每隔几分钟，你就会发现自己回到飞船，只是为了摘掉头盔，再重新戴上，然后继续。

这些都不好玩。也并不是特别真实。它们只是玩家学会尽快忍受并绕开的怪癖。与其说是在享受游戏，不如说常常感觉像是在与它笨重繁琐的系统和可疑的设计选择作斗争。

我很想推荐这款游戏，尽管有这些问题，我可能还是会继续玩，但对大多数人来说，我会说除非你愿意忍受挫败感，否则还是避开吧。

Sadly I can't recommend the game in its current state.

There are just to many bugs and the movement is very clunky, interrupting any game flow. For example, you can't queue actions and always have to quit actions manually before switching to another task.

Additionally, the devs don't really care about bugs. Instead, they choose to confront the players with random pop-ups of error messages. For example the camera rotation is dysfunctional while docking your ship. They could have fixed that, but instead they decide to let pop up annoying error messages, whenever one tries to rotate the world view.

This all leads to a tedious and frustrating gameplay.

items.text:
Look, honestly, its one of those times I'd say a neutral review is in order, because the tension, the progression- from the very start to what I'd roughly consider 'midgame' (a very vague term because this game is exceptionally freeform, but for my example, roughly when you get your first crewmember) its great- theres quirks just about everywhere, things that seem important that aren't, things that are important but aren't made clear, etc- its great in the sense of exploration and giving you space to be player directed.

The problems come up when you get your ship larger- wanna do a complicated airlock that isn't your ship's docking port? You have literally only on and off switches to do that. They can be 'kinda' complicated and 'sorta' automated, but ultimately you'll be probably toggling two switches and its very... involved to operate it. And for some reason- at least in my game, the airlock ALWAYS leaked air despite the doors being closed. VERY frustrating- Only if the exterior door was unpowered did it not leak air.
You want your crew to consistently work during their working time? No dice, they'll more or less do whatever they want even with orders waiting- I didn't have this happen too often, and I'm willing to wave this off- if the game wants to simulate complex characters, then well- your workers might not work every hour of the day they're assigned, perfectly fine. I actually semi like this 'feature' if that is what it is.
You want your crewmember to actually use their freetime rather than sleeping during it? Well, thats another thing you can't really control. Also fine, but just a touch irritating- considering the idea is they'd fulfill their other needs during that freetime- their priorities seem always just a little wrong- he's tired, but he also needs to go take a dump- why not? oh, but he's also dirty, so he cleans himself first, then goes to sleep, and presumably he'll wake up to take a dump later, disrupting the actual sleep periods- which uhh, has gameplay detriments because they sleep LESS EFFECTIVELY during a non sleep shift!

Oh, and the fast forward option isn't really 'fast forwards' its more like 'skip these hours and depending on what actions are being done, increase attributes' which is SO very WRONG. Useful for training skills, TERRIBLE for actual gameplay- where you have to 'game' your fastfoward usage. I'd rather the game check all the facilities available on your ship and decrease requisite needs to zero when fast forwarding at this point. And time on the fastest -not fast forwards- speed is remarkably slow- you have 'a lot' of time. A lot of waiting. I didn't mind this, until I realized how incapable of the NPCS are to handling their own needs- even during freetime when they're suppose to. Yea, I'm not gonna lie, my initial plan to play this game was to make a long hauler to haul cargo between places and almost handle it like sims during the journey- a task thats implied to take in game days depending on where but I still haven't gotten there quite yet- but the need management is awful because it screws you on both fronts- either you play through the time legitimately and jump between your characters as you cycle through their needs- which wouldn't give much gameplay. Or you fastfowards and have to sorta do 'batches' of handling needs with the pure intent to just get there.

Then, finally, performance... The job assignment system is... Extremely inefficient. I don't have words to begin- if you order enough things to happen, your game will crawl as your crew and characters check 'every' single one of them for availability- now, this is partially because every freaking order is handled in like three parts- you order floor to be constructed. So what happens is they first check if it can be immediately done- makes sense... But typically, it cannot- it needs the floors delivered. Fine- you can either have loose floors from what you were salvaging or carried them with you (there are problems on this too- like certain items not stacking and or otherwise inefficencies that are painful regarding constructions.) Except for the fact that it first tries to do EVERY single floor job- which will lag your game as they replan to bring the floors to the job- and then they will bring floors ONE BY ONE (A item that stacks to five- oh and this also affects hauling floors) to each of the planned floors. So either you take direct control and tell them to pick up as many floors as they can, or you watch as you visibly age in the inky blackness of your unfinished construction slowly gets every floor delivered. Then it can start building. (EDIT:BTW planned walls block character movement as if they're actually there, and doors do it too, but only occasionally- pretty annoying.)

but wait, that needs battery power in your tools- and if you forget- then suddenly your guy is just twiddling his thumbs wasting time and leaving you confused- you learn to check their tools battery percentages pretty fast after noticing they're not working once you figure it out, but changing batteries is a three action interaction- you open the tool, you open the container with your batteries, you swap batteries. Furthermore, they can't tend to their own suit needs either- they won't even take off their helmet if they're in a safe environment to do so to conserve suit resources. I've seen NPCs suffocate ON STATIONS (extremely rare, they do usually take off their helmet once their suit is out of resources if they're in a safe zone, but still) because of this situation.

The situation is that all of these are individual situations that aren't 'too' big of a problem when individually confronted, but all of them at the same time? In a game asking you to operate a nuclear reactor? With the reward being 'the game will behave itself a little better' if you consistently solve each of these problems as they come up 'for' the game?

The game is excellent when you're a single guy on a scrapped together ship- clunky, but it feels a lot more meaningful when you're a solo guy whos doing literially everything you can to get out of a situation of being broke and effectively doing death runs to change your fate. Its once you start dreaming bigger, wanting to do more than cobble- wanting to make yourself a identity- is where the game starts fumbling.

Despite all of this, if there is one thing you can take away from my review- is that I have enjoyed my time with it despite my grouchiness with the systems. There is excellence here. But ultimately I think that until things are worked on even further than they have been- I would never think to recommend this to someone who asks for a space game- This has the bones to be one of the very best ones out there, it does so many things better than a innumerable number of other games- and if not better, at least individually worthwhile. This is a great game, but only worthwhile to those who have looked at it, and said 'This game is way too cool to pass up on' and is willing to bear with all of the difficulties with just playing the game that don't come from trying to survive in the game.
items.text_zh:
听着，老实说，这时候我会说给个中评是合适的，因为那种紧张感、那种推进——从最开始到我大致认为的“中期”（这个词很模糊，因为这游戏异常自由，但就我的例子而言，大约是你得到第一个船员的时候）它很棒——到处都有怪癖，看似重要其实不重要的事，重要但没被说清楚的事，等等——它在探索感和给你空间让玩家主导这方面很棒。

问题出现在你把船造得更大的时候——想做一个不是飞船对接舱口的复杂气闸？你实际上只有开和关的开关来做这件事。它们可以“有点”复杂，“算是”自动化，但最终你大概会拨动两个开关，操作起来非常……繁琐。而且不知为何——至少在我的游戏里，气闸即使门关着也总是漏气。非常令人沮丧——只有在外门没通电时才不漏气。
你想让你的船员在工作时间持续工作？没门，他们或多或少会为所欲为，即使有订单在等着——我遇到这种情况不太多，我也愿意对此睁一只眼闭一只眼——如果游戏想模拟复杂的角色，那么好吧——你的工人可能不会在分配给他们的每一天的每个小时都工作，完全没问题。如果这算是个“特性”，我其实半喜欢这个“特性”。
你想让你的船员在空闲时间真正利用空闲而不是睡觉？嗯，那是另一件你其实控制不了的事。也行，但就是有点恼人——考虑到本意是他们会在这段空闲时间里满足其他需求——他们的优先级似乎总是有点不对——他累了，但他也需要去拉屎——为什么不呢？哦，但他还脏，所以他先清洁自己，然后去睡觉，大概之后会醒来去拉屎，打乱实际的睡眠时段——呃，这有游戏玩法上的坏处，因为他们在非睡眠班次睡觉效率更低！

哦，还有快进选项并不是真的“快进”，它更像是“跳过这些小时，并根据正在进行的动作增加属性”，这实在太不对了。用来训练技能有用，对实际游玩很糟糕——你得“算计”着用快进。到这份上我宁愿游戏在快进时检查你船上所有可用设施，并把所需需求降到零。而最快——不是快进——速度下的时间慢得惊人——你有“很多”时间。很多等待。我本来不介意，直到我意识到NPC多么无能，连自己的需求都处理不好——即使在空闲时间，本该处理的时候。是的，不骗你，我最初玩这游戏的计划是造一艘长途货运船在各地之间运货，在旅途中几乎像模拟人生那样管理——这个任务暗示会根据地点花上游戏里的好几天，但我还没到那一步——但需求管理很糟糕，因为它在两方面都坑你——要么你老老实实玩过这段时间，在角色之间跳来跳去循环处理他们的需求——这不会带来多少玩法。要么你快进，然后不得不带着纯粹只想赶紧到那里的意图，像“批量”处理需求那样操作。

然后，最后，性能……工作分配系统……极其低效。我都不知道从何说起——如果你下令让足够多的事情发生，你的游戏会爬行，因为你的船员和角色会检查“每一个”任务的可用性——现在，这部分是因为每个该死的订单都分三部分处理——你下令建造地板。那么发生的是他们先检查能不能立刻做——合理……但通常不能——它需要地板被送达。行——你可以用打捞来的散装地板，或者随身带着（这方面也有问题——比如某些物品不能堆叠，以及其他在建造方面令人痛苦的效率低下。）除了这个事实：它会先尝试做每一个地板工作——这会让你的游戏卡顿，因为他们重新规划把地板送到工作地点——然后他们会把地板一个一个地送（一个能堆叠到五的物品——哦，这也影响搬运地板）到每个计划中的地板。所以要么你直接控制，告诉他们尽可能多拿地板，要么你看着自己在未完工建筑的漆黑中明显变老，地板慢慢被送达。然后它才能开始建造。（编辑：顺便说一句，计划中的墙会像实际存在一样阻挡角色移动，门也会，但只是偶尔——挺烦人的。）

但等等，那需要你工具里的电池电量——如果你忘了——那么突然你的家伙就只是闲着浪费时间，让你一头雾水——你很快学会检查他们工具的电池百分比，在注意到他们不工作并弄明白原因之后，但换电池是三个动作的交互——你打开工具，你打开装电池的容器，你换电池。此外，他们也不能照顾自己宇航服的需求——即使在安全环境里，他们也不会为了节省宇航服资源而摘下头盔。我见过NPC在空间站上窒息（极其罕见，他们通常会在宇航服资源耗尽后在安全区摘下头盔，但还是有）因为这种情况。

情况是，所有这些单独面对时都不是“太”大的问题，但全部同时出现呢？在一个要求你操作核反应堆的游戏里？而奖励是“如果你持续为游戏解决每一个出现的问题，游戏会表现得好一点”？

当你是一个人在一艘拼凑起来的船上时，这游戏非常出色——笨拙，但当你是一个独行侠，做着字面意义上一切能做的事来摆脱破产的处境，实际上进行死亡冲刺来改变命运时，感觉有意义得多。一旦你开始梦想更大，想做的不只是拼凑——想给自己一个身份——游戏就开始踉跄了。

尽管如此，如果你能从我的评测里带走一件事——那就是尽管我对这些系统满腹牢骚，我还是享受了和它相处的时间。这里有卓越之处。但最终我认为，除非事情比现在被进一步改进——我绝不会想到向一个要太空游戏的人推荐这个——它有成为市面上最优秀游戏之一的骨架，它在无数方面比数不清的其他游戏做得更好——如果不是更好，至少单独来看也值得。这是一款很棒的游戏，但只对那些看过它并说“这游戏太酷了不能错过”并愿意忍受所有仅仅是在玩这游戏（而非在游戏里求生）所带来的困难的人才值得。

Just say no. This game requires a huge time commitment to get anything done. I love the IDEA of this game, but the actual game mechanics are, in places, kind of trash.  Examples:

- Rebuild a basic starter ship and get it to a useable level of functionality? Two to four hours of game play at minimum.  
- Rebuild a medium sized ship with lots of changes once you outgrow your starter ship? Plan on loosing a couple evenings and an easy eight hours and likely many more in real life.
- Now that you have a freshly rebuilt ship that you literally dumped all of those real life hours into creating and customizing, expect the wear and maintenance mechanics to require you to touch every last component on that ship every in-game weak or so.  Cost is another hour or two of real-life time watching your character grind out queued up repairs or letting them run around randomly on autotask every couple of play sessions.
- Want to fly between planetary systems, it takes a minimum of an hour or sometimes two in real time, all the while doing nothing but having your character sleep and using the game's super fast forward mode.

So why not do something actually fun during that time instead?  The game has a completely inane mechanic that looks at how long the player had the game running in real time, and anywhere outside staring area it applies significant damage about every ten minutes. Need to do something IRL with the game paused, be prepared to get zapped once you come off the pause button.  The timed damage mechanic does not affect early game play, it only starts to pound you once have a bunch of hours invested in a play-through and want to move beyond the starting game-play loop. This is why most players will never really be impacted by it before they write a review.

There are some other issues as well.

- Your crew feel like giving orders to "Dwarf Fortress" dwarves from like 10-15 years ago; you cannot actually trust them to reliably keep themselves alive, although they mostly kind of do what you ask.  You will also need to make sure your toddler crew gets their food, water, goes potty, and goes beddie-bye.
- The ship salvage and building/rebuilding part of the game has very clicky mechanics, and in the latest pre-release those mechanics went from bad to worse. You used to just have to focus and interact with a series of tiny sections on the screen while the rest was covered in graphical clutter. Now they "improved" that by reducing the graphical clutter, but also taking what was already a clicky, grindy mess and making it even slower and more unreliable for item placement.
- The space and orbital mechanics are .. um ...interesting?  If you were hoping for KSP or X4 style flight mechanics this will not deliver.  Space is a flat 2d, and the orbital mechanics seem to be hard coded as opposed to physics driven.  Parts of this are fun, but discard any sim thinking at the title screen.

The early game is a lot of fun, and well worth the price of entry.  Once past that the game-play quality goes way down and gets grindy with bad mechanics.  Hopefully the dev team figures things out and goes back to finding the fun this game has the potential to offer.

Finally let's talk bugs:
There is not one single game-play mechanic in this game that is not subject problematic behavior and things occasionally not working as expected. Yes, the game is early access and some of this is expected.  But even in early access I would expect some systems to be bug free. I have yet to experience one in this game. Unfortunately that also means that while most game breaking bugs are being or have been addressed, even those still show up with surprising regularity in unexpected times and places. Play the game long enough and even on the latest builds you will hit things that for you to reload back to a save and loose game advancement. I have never played a single session where I've been in the game for more than an hour or so with encountering at least minor bugs that routinely frustrate me.

I really want the game to mature and succeed, it does have a lot of potential. It may require some adult guidance to get there.

直接说不吧。这款游戏需要投入大量时间才能做成任何事。我喜欢这款游戏的理念，但实际的游戏机制在某些地方简直就是垃圾。例如：

- 重建一艘基础的新手船并让它达到可用的功能水平？至少需要两到四个小时的游戏时间。
- 当你不再满足于新手船后，重建一艘有大量改动的中型飞船？准备好失去几个晚上，轻松花上八个小时，在现实生活中很可能还要多得多。
- 现在你有一艘刚刚重建好的飞船，你确实把那些现实生活中的小时全都倾注在创建和定制它上面了，那就等着磨损和维护机制要求你每隔一个游戏内星期左右就得触碰那艘船上的每一个部件吧。代价是再花一两个小时的现实时间，看着你的角色把排队的修理任务磨完，或者每隔几次游戏就让它们在自动任务下到处乱跑。
- 想在行星系之间飞行？至少需要一个小时，有时是两个小时的现实时间，全程除了让你的角色睡觉、使用游戏的超快进模式之外什么也做不了。

那为什么不在这段时间里做点真正有趣的事呢？游戏有一个完全荒唐的机制，它会查看玩家让游戏在现实时间中运行了多久，而在起始区域之外的任何地方，它大约每十分钟就会施加一次可观的伤害。需要在游戏暂停时去做现实中的事情？准备好一旦你松开暂停键就被电一下吧。这个定时伤害机制不影响早期游戏，只有当你已经在一个存档里投入了大量小时、想要超越起始游戏循环时，它才开始猛击你。这就是为什么大多数玩家在写评测之前永远不会真正受到它的影响。

还有一些其他问题。

- 你的船员感觉就像在给大约10到15年前的《矮人要塞》矮人下命令；你不能真正信任他们能可靠地保住自己的命，尽管他们大体上还算会做你要求的事。你还得确保你的幼儿船员们有饭吃、有水喝、去上厕所、乖乖上床睡觉。
- 游戏的飞船打捞和建造/重建部分有着非常依赖点击的机制，而在最新的预发布版中，那些机制从糟糕变得更糟。以前你只需要集中注意力，与屏幕上的一系列微小区域互动，而其余部分则被图形杂乱物覆盖。现在他们通过减少图形杂乱物来“改进”了这一点，但同时也把原本就已经是点击、刷磨的烂摊子变得更慢，物品放置也更不可靠。
- 太空和轨道力学……嗯……挺有意思？如果你期待的是KSP或X4风格的飞行力学，这款游戏不会满足你。太空是平面的2D，轨道力学似乎是硬编码的，而不是物理驱动的。其中有些部分很有趣，但在标题画面就把任何模拟游戏的思维丢掉吧。

早期游戏非常有趣，完全值回入场价。一旦过了那个阶段，游戏质量就大幅下降，变得又刷又磨，机制还很糟糕。希望开发团队能搞清楚状况，回到寻找这款游戏有潜力提供的乐趣上来。

最后来说说bug：
这款游戏里没有任何一个游戏机制不存在问题行为，也不存在偶尔不按预期运作的情况。是的，游戏是抢先体验版，其中一些是意料之中的。但即便在抢先体验版中，我也会期望有些系统是没有bug的。我还没有在这款游戏中体验到一个。不幸的是，这也意味着虽然大多数破坏游戏的bug正在被解决或已经被解决，但即便是那些bug仍然会以惊人的频率在意想不到的时间和地点出现。玩得够久，即便在最新的版本上，你也会撞上一些让你不得不读档重来、损失游戏进度的事情。我从来没有玩过一次超过一小时左右的游戏会话而不遇到至少一些经常让我感到沮丧的小bug。

我真的很希望这款游戏能成熟并成功，它确实有很大潜力。可能需要一些成年人的指导才能走到那一步。

[[Early Access Review]]

While the concept of this game is something Ive been looking for in a game for quite awhile the flying mechanic just gets so tedious so quick that it ruins the fun from the other aspects of the game.  Trying to manage your social needs that degrade so quickly and trying to manage the poor AI of your crew also get tiring quite quickly.

Now I love the cassette Futurism theme of the game, the abailty to tear down floating space wrecks to sell scrap to make money and to upgrade and build out your own ship.  If the devs can tighten up the AI for the crew members, tweak how the social needs work and really adjust how flight controls work, honestly theres a place where ultra realism starts killing the fun and the Newtonian Physics here where you need to manually adjust every last aspect really crossed over that line to make it unfun and tedious.

Will check back in on this title in the next 6 months as I do really hope this can become a true diamond in the rough, at which point I will update my review to reflect how it stands then.

[[抢先体验评测]]

虽然这款游戏的概念正是我长期以来一直在游戏中寻找的东西，但飞行机制很快就变得如此繁琐，以至于破坏了游戏其他方面的乐趣。试图管理那些退化得如此之快社交需求，以及试图管理你那糟糕的船员AI，也很快就让人感到疲惫。

不过我喜欢这款游戏的卡带未来主义主题，能够拆解漂浮的太空残骸，把废料卖掉赚钱，并升级和建造自己的飞船。如果开发者能够收紧船员的AI，调整社交需求的运作方式，并真正调整飞行控制的运作方式，说实话，有些地方极端写实开始扼杀乐趣，而这里的牛顿物理学要求你手动调整每一个细节，真的越过了那条线，让它变得不好玩且繁琐。

我会在接下来的6个月里再回来看看这款作品，因为我真的希望它能成为一块真正的璞玉，到那时我会更新我的评测以反映它当时的状态。

items.text:
Whilst this game could allow for a lot replayability it has problems.

It lacks basic features that would improve the game a lot, it is needlessly complicated in some areas and front loaded. Yet somehow shallow. It lacks info about what anything does, like player traits.

Here is some simple things, what I think it needs as a priority:
Unable to quit to main menu from character creation, in case you pressed wrong button or wanna try again. 'Continue' on titlescreen is often for continuing a last save, should probably be called 'load'.
For some reason container items need to be interacting with and you need to select 'inventory'. Look I love inventory management, heck I love CDDA, but requiring the game to be unpaused to look at your items is not good. I cannot stress the amount this reduced my enjoyment. Having to check everythings inventory is tedious.
Unable to label or change name of items, that glass bottle of 'vodka' you have for coffee? Yeah your gonna have to use the previous inventory checking each time you want to go through your stuff, as you can't tell at a glance what's in it?
Using control to pick up single items from a stack is impossible, you use control to instead 'place' one from the stack? Seems backwards.
Kicks you out of nav panel on ships when closing the ship menu, very annoying when you are learning the game and after still annoying.
No way to 'cancel' a move command easily.
The ship travel menu is a mess, trying to move around the map is sensitive and annoying, Trying to figure out your heading AND viewing your target is very difficult. This COULD be forgiven if better navigation parts are added later, but I seriously doubt such poor UI would be on every ship in galaxy. You can't even get predictions on where an object is travel that you have targeted, or even the angle between you and the target.

Other areas to improve:
The OST is not very good, it could use better music. I turned it off after a bit. The first one is good for the character creation though.
Traits that do nothing.
Poor variety of items and parts, every ship starts to look the same in terms of parts.
All ships have the same UI?
Some traits or skills aren't trainable?
Unclear to the players when stuff needs to be paid.
No 'buffer' for new characters from fees, means 100% your first character you spent time on will be a waste, should be able to 'pre' save already built characters with same parents, etc.
Changing your last name does not affect your origins.
All the 'mothers' I get look like dudes, tested 8/10 times, same with weird looking fathers. Why assign parents at all? They don't appear to affect your story in the slightest? Character creation options are limited, n general the options for females in particular are bad, I tried playing a few times and once it gave me a female character, after wasting time making a character I realised that it just puts a different face only, it kinda looks goofy on top of the default male body. But across the board it is lacking, you can't even make a character that looks like the loading screens... or even 'normal' looking.
The loan system for your ship seems a bit weird? You can loan for a $800,000 ship, but can't for a $80,000 + some extra like gear? Or a license? I dunno man. Stuff doesn't make sense, in the description of one ship it mentions you worked on it... why can't you work on the cheapest ship?
The LONG saving times, are an issue.
The character creation is sometimes annoying, 'seek ship' should not show the same ship more then once, even if it adds more time the next time you look.
NPCs steal your items? Items disappearing? Had to reload as a core item like my helmet disappeared.
Uninstalling parts in your ship and they appear outside the ship... serious issue as there is no way to go outside? Even from port?


I tried to enjoy this game as it seems to have all the elements for a game I would enjoy but it is half baked at least for now and I just don't. It ain't even that deep either, even though it seems complicated up front, once you play a little bit it is a really simple game.

Still all that said I still think this will be a good game after some updates, unfortunately from what I can see that would take at least 3 years at current rate of development to where I would consider this game playable.
items.text_zh:
虽然这款游戏可能允许大量重复游玩，但它存在问题。

它缺乏能大幅改善游戏的基础功能，在某些方面不必要地复杂且前置内容过多。然而不知怎的又很浅薄。它缺乏关于任何东西作用的说明，比如玩家特质。

以下是一些简单的事情，我认为它需要优先处理：
无法从角色创建退出到主菜单，以防你按错了按钮或想再试一次。标题画面上的“继续”通常是用来继续上次存档的，可能应该叫“加载”。
不知为何容器物品需要与之互动，然后你需要选择“库存”。听着，我喜欢库存管理，见鬼，我喜欢CDDA，但要求游戏取消暂停才能查看你的物品并不好。我无法强调这减少了我多少乐趣。不得不检查每样东西的库存很乏味。
无法给物品贴标签或更改名称，你那瓶用来配咖啡的“伏特加”玻璃瓶？是啊，每次你想翻找你的东西时，都得用之前说的检查库存，因为你无法一眼看出里面是什么？
使用control从一堆物品中拾取单个物品是不可能的，你用control反而是从堆里“放置”一个？似乎反了。
在飞船上关闭飞船菜单时，会把你踢出导航面板，在你学习游戏时非常烦人，之后仍然烦人。
没有简单的方法“取消”移动命令。
飞船旅行菜单一团糟，试图在地图上移动既敏感又烦人，试图弄清你的航向同时查看你的目标非常困难。如果以后加入更好的导航部件，这还可以原谅，但我严重怀疑银河系每艘飞船上都会有这么糟糕的UI。你甚至无法获得你所瞄准物体移动方向的预测，甚至无法获得你与目标之间的角度。

其他需要改进的地方：
原声带不太好，可以用更好的音乐。我听了一会儿就关掉了。不过第一首对角色创建来说不错。
毫无作用的特质。
物品和部件种类贫乏，每艘飞船在部件方面开始看起来都一样。
所有飞船都有相同的UI？
有些特质或技能无法训练？
玩家不清楚什么时候需要付费。
新角色没有针对费用的“缓冲”，意味着你花时间创建的第一个角色100%会白费，应该能够“预先”保存已经创建好的、拥有相同父母等的角色。
更改你的姓氏不会影响你的出身。
我得到的所有“母亲”看起来都像男人，测试了8/10次，长相奇怪的“父亲”也一样。为什么要分配父母呢？他们似乎丝毫不影响你的故事？角色创建选项有限，总的来说尤其是女性的选项很糟糕，我试玩了几次，有一次给了我一个女性角色，在浪费时间创建角色后我意识到它只是换了一张不同的脸，放在默认男性身体上看起来有点滑稽。但总体而言它很欠缺，你甚至无法创建一个看起来像加载画面里的角色……甚至看起来“正常”的都不行。
你飞船的贷款系统似乎有点奇怪？你可以贷款买一艘800,000美元的飞船，但不能贷款买一艘80,000美元加一些额外东西比如装备的？或者一张执照？我不知道，老兄。事情说不通，在一艘飞船的描述中提到你曾在它上面工作过……为什么你不能在最便宜的飞船上工作？
漫长的保存时间是个问题。
角色创建有时很烦人，“寻找飞船”应该
不要在你下次查看时再次显示同一艘飞船，即使这会增加更多时间。
NPC会偷你的物品？物品消失？不得不重新加载，因为像我的头盔这样的核心物品消失了。
卸载你飞船上的部件，它们却出现在飞船外面……严重问题，因为根本没有办法出去？甚至从港口也不行？


我试着享受这款游戏，因为它似乎具备了一款我会喜欢的游戏的所有元素，但至少目前它是半生不熟的，我就是不喜欢。它甚至也没那么有深度，尽管乍一看似乎很复杂，一旦你玩上一小会儿，它其实是一款非常简单的游戏。

尽管如此，我仍然认为在经过一些更新后这会是一款好游戏，不幸的是，据我所见，以目前的开发速度，至少需要3年才能达到我认为这款游戏可玩的程度。

I have to say, this game has a LOT of quirks and a control scheme that's slightly non-standard.  It takes some getting used to (for instance items can be on the same square, repeated right-clicking to cycle through them, etc).  Getting started can definitely feel a bit hopeless to beginners, you have to learn the ropes (do some in-station courier gigs if you're getting behind on payments or don't have money for fuel).

It quickly becomes pretty addictive though.  Recommended.

** More detail below ***
I was just headed back toward the K-LEG station and installing a sink and door in the bathroom I was building out in my ship as it coasted toward the station with twenty minutes to go.  I had aimed it 10 degrees to the left and outside the orbit of the station around the asteroid just in case I overshot (avoiding a terrible collision).  After installing the door, it was damaged so I was stuck inside.  I tried to repair, but didn't have the parts.  So I just uninstalled a wall (much faster than uninstalling the door) and went around.  Within that time, I'd started passing the station. Good thing I took precautions.

I decided to sleep in the station because I'd stayed out for almost the entire 24h salvage license period.  They charged me every hour, cost around $6K at least :P  Oh well, the freighter I salvaged had about half a fusion setup, I had repaired quite a bit of it and made a good $120K on the black market.
Leaving, I hailed station traffic control and requested undocking clearance (yeah, they'll lock your ship in if you owe them money).  At the nav station, I can see ships coming and going, within 5km you get a proximity alert and it gets higher as they get closer...I got undocking clearance and hit the clamps button, releasing my ship.  Boosted back and right.  Drifted, proximit alert - zoomed out, a ship coming in ahead and to the right.  Waited for it to get out of the way, got a bit of distance, then boosted forward, watching for traffic (near the station you have to watch out more).
Going to hit one of the further out ships, maybe I'll get another freighter.
items.text_zh:
我得说，这款游戏有非常多的怪癖，还有一个稍微非标准的操控方案。需要花些时间适应（比如物品可以放在同一个格子上，反复右键点击来循环切换它们，等等）。对新手来说，上手绝对会感觉有点绝望，你得学会门道（如果你拖欠付款或没钱买燃料，就做些空间站内的快递活儿）。

不过它很快就会变得相当上瘾。推荐。

** 更多细节见下 ***
我当时正朝着K-LEG空间站返回，一边在飞船里建造的浴室中安装水槽和门，飞船正滑向空间站，还有二十分钟。我把它瞄准了左侧10度、空间站绕小行星轨道的外侧，以防我冲过头（避免可怕的碰撞）。安装完门后，门受损了，所以我被困在里面。我试着修理，但没有零件。于是我就直接拆掉了一面墙（比拆门快得多），绕了过去。在这段时间里，我已经开始经过空间站了。还好我做了预防措施。

我决定睡在空间站里，因为我几乎在外面待满了整个24小时的打捞许可证期限。他们每小时都收费，至少花了大约6000美元 :P 算了，我打捞的那艘货船有大约一半的聚变装置，我已经修复了不少，在黑市上赚了12万美元。
离开时，我呼叫了空间站交通管制，请求解除对接许可（是的，如果你欠他们钱，他们会把你的飞船锁住）。在导航站，我能看到飞船来来往往，5公里内你会收到接近警报，它们越近警报声越高……我获得了解除对接许可，按下了夹钳按钮，释放了我的飞船。向右后方加速。漂移，接近警报——拉远视角，一艘飞船从前方右侧驶来。等它让开，拉开了一点距离，然后向前加速，留意交通（在空间站附近你得多加小心）。
打算去撞一艘更外围的飞船，也许我能再弄到一艘货船。

items.text:
I'm going to recommend this specifically to anyone who's played/is familiar with NEO Scavenger and wants to support the devs while the game is in EA. For casual players, there really isn't enough content and most of the gameplay elements haven't been implemented/fleshed out yet.

I will say that what [i] is [/i] in the game right now is very promising. Likes its predecessor, Ostranauts is dense, atmospheric, and challenging. But instead of dying of an infection alone in the wilderness, Ostranauts has you dying of hypoxia alone (or potentially with a crew) in space. My first few characters died in minutes while I tried to figure out how to fly, how to dock my ship, how to patch holes in the hull after docking attempts went awry, etc. 

As difficult as it can be in practice, the current gameplay loop is easily summarized: fly to derelict ships, salvage them for parts, then integrate those parts into your ship or sell them on the black market for cash. If you're operating without a one-day license, be on the lookout for the law while you're working. Alternatively, if you find a derelict with some nice parts already installed in it, you can fix it up and take it for yourself. As of Update 0.7.0.3, you can also take on randomized timed jobs that range from delivery to espionage missions. 

After 8 hours I've only just started to figure out how to build my fortune by carving out the best parts from a derelict and selling them at the port. Now that I'm settling in, I can appreciate the game's systems and interface. The switches and buttons on the nav station, while extremely intimidating at first, are very satisfying once mastered. Little touches like the overlay that appears when you put on your space helmet are immersive. The equipment system is similar to NEO Scavenger and after some adjustment is surprisingly intuitive. (The caveat to all of this is if you hate games that require a lot of clicking. Everything in this game requires multiple clicks. Many clicks).

There are bugs, of course. The worst I've encountered so far is everyone in the entire home port suddenly getting spaced. I'm not sure if a hole opened up somewhere, but I couldn't find the cause. Everything was fine after loading my game, but something like this could potentially ruin a save. I've also had my character start randomly suffocating on space stations, only to recover after moving away from where I had been standing.

Finally, the devs have said that they want Ostranauts to be a game that generates stories. So far, I think they're on the right track. Similar to Rimworld, so many things can happen, both good and bad. Sometimes things happen one after another. Sometimes they happen all at once. I think once it's complete, Ostranauts will be a game where you can be hit by sudden, unavoidable disaster, or miraculously pull yourself out of certain doom. And either way, it will be a blast.
items.text_zh:
我特别要向那些玩过/熟悉《NEO Scavenger》并且想在游戏处于抢先体验阶段时支持开发者的人推荐这款游戏。对于休闲玩家来说，内容确实不够多，而且大多数玩法元素还没有被实现/充实完善。

我要说的是，目前游戏里[i]已经存在[/i]的内容非常有前景。和它的前作一样，《Ostranauts》内容密集、氛围浓厚且富有挑战性。但不同于在荒野中独自死于感染，《Ostranauts》让你在太空中独自（或可能与船员一起）死于缺氧。我的前几个角色在几分钟内就死了，当时我还在试图弄清楚怎么飞行、怎么停靠飞船、在停靠尝试出岔子后怎么修补船体上的破洞等等。

尽管实际操作起来可能很难，但当前的玩法循环很容易概括：飞往废弃飞船，拆解它们获取零件，然后把这些零件整合到你的飞船里，或者在黑市上卖掉换钱。如果你没有一日许可证就开工，干活时要留意法律。或者，如果你发现一艘已经装有一些不错零件的废弃飞船，你可以把它修好并据为己有。截至0.7.0.3更新，你还可以接取随机限时工作，范围从送货到间谍任务都有。

玩了8个小时后，我才刚刚开始弄明白如何通过从废弃飞船中拆下最好的零件并在港口出售来发家致富。现在我逐渐上手了，也能欣赏游戏的系统和界面了。导航站上的开关和按钮，起初虽然极其令人生畏，但一旦掌握就非常令人满足。一些小细节，比如戴上太空头盔时出现的叠加显示，很有沉浸感。装备系统类似于《NEO Scavenger》，经过一番调整后出乎意料地直观。（这一切的前提是，如果你讨厌需要大量点击的游戏，那就另当别论了。这款游戏里的一切都需要多次点击。很多次点击。）

当然，游戏里有bug。我目前遇到的最糟糕的一个是整个母港里的所有人突然都被抛入太空。我不确定是不是哪里开了个洞，但我找不到原因。读档后一切正常，但这种事有可能毁掉一个存档。我还遇到过我的角色在空间站上开始随机窒息，只有在离开我原先站着的位置后才恢复。

最后，开发者说过他们希望《Ostranauts》成为一款能生成故事的游戏。到目前为止，我认为他们走在正确的轨道上。和《Rimworld》类似，很多事情都可能发生，有好有坏。有时事情一件接一件地发生。有时它们同时发生。我认为一旦完成，《Ostranauts》将会是一款你可能遭遇突如其来的、无法避免的灾难，或者奇迹般地把自已从必死无疑中拉出来的游戏。而无论哪种情况，都会非常过瘾。

[Edit after a few more hours into the game 16 Sept 2020]

It's an open/sandbox game where you start with a simple pod with a battery and barely enough energy to a scrapyard where you'll start salvaging broken ships to expand yours.

It kinda reminds me of Barotrauma for the idea of ship complexity but with the full liberty of creation and of Hellion, for the free roaming/exploration/salvaging/navigation, both games I love.
The idea is great and allows a lot of freedom in creating your very own ship.There are interesting game mechanisms for object placement, connections, air, temperature,  electricity and so on.There seems to be quite a fair amount of randomly generated narrative, for instance at the creation of your character. 
Some panels, like the docking or the reactor, are really nice and add a lot to the immersion, I love it.
Graphics are a very poor 3d but it's a style I don't mind actually.
Thanks to the few patches of the first days, I've been able to navigate a bit and dock to the first derelicts. 
Generated randomly between another rescue pod or a large spaceship, in a poor or rather ok state.

Now, onto the very bad parts.
Even though I should be tolerant with an early access game, it is difficultly playable and very grindy.
- All actions take a lot of time, (but you can accelerate time)
- Cursor location bugs, where you need to restart the game every so often.
- Docking procedure very unclear, I understood that one, you have to face the derelict with the tip of your ship even though your airlock is at the back... Once you know
- very harsh balance where you'll grind heavy objects and sell them to get a very necessary tool at the beginning
- also, not helping, most of the derelicts are so broken that you can't even enter them at the beginning
- swapping the batteries at the beginning is a chore and you'll end unlucky by finding no derelict with reactor to recharge them on
- very little progression/objective at the moment, but I'm sure it will be corrected.
- items that you lose for no good reason
- stuffs you can't remove
- some of the sounds in this game are also kinda horrific, like proximity alarms that will not shut down when docked
- some bugs are actually favorable like infinite O2
- lack of quick options to do stuffs like undocking
- pieces of the ship that are not repaired yet with no indication
- items that you cannot place on the floor where you want and you have to keep taking and dropping them until they are where you want
- Pressure, mass, temperatures, gravity that go haywire
- and some more deadlier bugs where your ship will basically crash and be destroyed for no good reason due to bugs in undocking for instance.
The list is quite long

So basically, it feels like a game with nice game mechanics but not polished, extremely buggy and configured to be grindy with high chances of death and it questions why I'm spending time in the game. It really needs to become more friendly to the player.
I'm sure the game could become something in the end but unless you want to support the developer, to be avoided for now.

I'll likely change my mind in future updates and review this frequently

That kinda reminds me of the state of disarray that was Space Engineers at the beginning.

[在游戏里多玩几个小时后于2020年9月16日编辑]

这是一款开放/沙盒游戏，你一开始只有一个带电池的简易舱，能量勉强够你到达一个废料场，在那里你将开始打捞破损的飞船来扩展你自己的飞船。

它让我有点想起《Barotrauma》，因为飞船复杂性的理念，但拥有完全的创造自由；也让我想起《Hellion》，因为自由漫游/探索/打捞/航行，这两款游戏我都喜欢。
这个想法很棒，允许你在创建自己飞船时拥有很大的自由。对于物体放置、连接、空气、温度、电力等，都有有趣的游戏机制。似乎有相当数量的随机生成的叙事，例如在你创建角色时。
有些面板，比如对接或反应堆，真的很好，大大增加了沉浸感，我很喜欢。
画面是非常糟糕的3D，但这其实是一种我不介意的风格。
多亏了最初几天的几个补丁，我已经能够稍微航行一下，并对接到最初的几艘废弃飞船。
它们是在另一个救援舱或一艘大型飞船之间随机生成的，状态很差或还算可以。

现在，来说说非常糟糕的部分。
尽管我应该对一款抢先体验游戏保持宽容，但它很难玩，而且非常肝。
- 所有动作都要花很多时间，（但你可以加速时间）
- 光标位置bug，你需要时不时重启游戏。
- 对接程序非常不清楚，我搞明白了那一个，你必须用你飞船的尖端面对废弃飞船，尽管你的气闸在后方……一旦你知道了
- 非常严苛的平衡，你一开始得肝沉重的物体并把它们卖掉，才能得到一个非常必要的工具
- 而且，更糟的是，大多数废弃飞船破损得太严重，一开始你甚至无法进入它们
- 一开始更换电池是件苦差事，而且你会很不走运地发现没有一艘废弃飞船有反应堆可以给它们充电
- 目前进展/目标非常少，但我相信这会被修正。
- 你会无缘无故失去的物品
- 你无法移除的东西
- 这款游戏里有些声音也有点可怕，比如接近警报在对接后不会关闭
- 有些bug实际上是有利的，比如无限氧气
- 缺少快速执行诸如解除对接之类操作的选项
- 飞船尚未修复的部分没有任何指示
- 你无法把物品放在地板上你想要的位置，你必须不停地拿起又放下，直到它们到了你想要的位置
- 压力、质量、温度、重力会失控
- 还有一些更致命的bug，比如由于解除对接时的bug，你的飞船基本上会无缘无故坠毁并被摧毁。
这个清单相当长

所以基本上，感觉像是一款游戏机制不错但未经打磨、bug极多，并且被配置成很肝、死亡几率很高的游戏，这让我质疑自己为什么要花时间在这游戏里。它真的需要对玩家更友好一些。
我相信这款游戏最终可能会有所成就，但除非你想支持开发者，否则目前还是避开为好。

在未来的更新中我可能会改变想法，并经常重新评测

这让我有点想起《Space Engineers》刚开始时那种混乱状态。
